subtasks: Pick up two slices of bread, place them into the toaster, and press the lever down.
Pick up a second slice of bread from the rack and place it into the empty right slot of the toaster.
Pick up only the separated rightmost slice from the bread rack with the left gripper, pass it to the right gripper, and put it in the empty right toaster slot.
Press the toaster lever down, then return both arms to their starting poses.
Return both open grippers to their episode-start poses.
Use the right gripper to straighten the leaning second slice at the toaster and seat it fully upright in the right slot. Leave the first slice in the left slot.
With one slice in each slot, press the front toaster lever fully down and return the right arm to its start pose.
Press the toaster lever to the bottom of its track with the right fingertips, then release it and return home.
